description:
## Why This Exists

ServerStores::new_mem_impl() in server_stores.rs calls MessageAuthenticator::new_cloudflare_tls() (falling back to new_system_conf()) to create a DKIM authenticator. This creates a real DNS resolver connection (Cloudflare 1.1.1.1) during test setup. Tests using ServerStores::new_mem() may fail in network-isolated CI environments, or slow down due to DNS round-trips.

The DKIM authenticator is only used in the POST pipeline verification path, not in pure unit tests.

## Acceptance Criteria

Add a ServerStores::new_mem_no_dkim() variant for tests that don't need DKIM verification, backed by a no-op MessageAuthenticator that never contacts DNS.
title: server_stores.rs: new_mem() creates MessageAuthenticator with DNS resolver
